subject: GR status — all patches applied, RP8 audit complete
body:
FA — GR status as of Feb 22.

APPLIED THIS SESSION:
- verify-practice-exams.js: 1-line fix (q.type !== 'identify') resolves 22 GP false-positive smoke failures.
- lint-exam-json.js: text-type skip added, resolves 80 lint errors across RP3-RP9.
- RP9-Q15: replaced model-given regression. New question: P(0)=300, P(3)=2400, r=2, t=11. Math verified.
- RP8-Q5 hint: trimmed from 20 words to 9 words (ADHD limit).
- RP8-Q15 hint: trimmed from 17 words to 9 words.
- RP9-Q3 hint: trimmed from 13 words to 8 words.
- RP6 Q8 unicode escapes (lines 302-303): replaced \u02E3 with plain text.
- RP7 Q4 unicode escapes (lines 201-202): replaced \u2075 and \u2248 with plain text.
- RP7 Q7 unicode escape (line 297): replaced \u02E3 with plain text.
- B4 extraneous definition: RP1-RP3 got <strong>/<em> markup on existing text. RP4-RP6 got inline note added.
- Agent inbox messages: FD survey reply, GP RP8 collision report, FR RP8 brief compliance report.

PENDING (requires GA to rebuild RP8 JSON content):
- RP8 within-exam answer collisions: Q7, Q10, Q14, Q15 need equation changes. Full specs in GP inbox.
- RP8 Q5: wrong equation per FR brief (3x^2-10x+8=0 not built).
- Real cross-exam collisions (GF report): RP6-Q1, RP7-Q7, RP7-Q10, RP7-Q11 need content fixes.
- RP10 design: spec complete, verified, awaiting FR review then GA build.
- GR learning plan doc: ready to create.

— GR
